scenes.title: Congratulations on Stage
scenes.summary: After her acclaimed stage performance, actress Sandrine Kiberlain takes her curtain call to roaring applause, while her agent Gabriel congratulates her warmly backstage.

scenes.title: Backstage Confidences
scenes.summary: In her dressing room and later at a comedy club, Sandrine Kiberlain expresses frustration with conventional theater and her upcoming biopic, confessing to Gabriel that she craves an exciting artistic reinvention in comedy.

scenes.title: Morning at the Agency
scenes.summary: Arriving at ASK after a late night with Sandrine Kiberlain, Gabriel discusses the actress's unexpected artistic crisis with Andrea, revealing that she is reluctant to sign on for the upcoming historical film.

scenes.title: Flora's Arrival
scenes.summary: After being barred from the municipal daycare, Andréa arrives at the ASK agency carrying baby Flora in her arms, reassuring Gabriel that she can balance motherhood with managing the company's busy agenda.

scenes.title: Sandrine's Calling
scenes.summary: Pressured by Gabriel to sign on for a prestigious period drama directed by Danièle Thompson, Sandrine Kiberlain refuses to play another tearful role and reveals her sudden ambition to perform live comedy.

scenes.title: Camille's Debrief
scenes.summary: Returning from an intriguing business lunch, Camille playfully teases Hervé with an outrageous romantic prank before confirming that her professional opinions are genuinely valued at the agency.

scenes.title: Hervé's Last Take
scenes.summary: Finishing his final take on set, Hervé is surprised by the director Valérie with white lilies and glowing praise, leading to an unexpected offer of an additional day of shooting with an expanded role.

scenes.title: Panic at the Photocopier
scenes.summary: Gabriel vents to Andréa about Sandrine Kiberlain threatening to abandon a prestigious film for stand-up comedy. Andréa attempts to soothe him while describing the chaotic trials of single parenthood, only to realize in sudden panic that she left baby Flora by the office photocopier.

scenes.title: The Wolves' Shelter
scenes.summary: Determined to acquire the screen rights to Ulrika Desrosières's bestselling novel, Mathias Barneville visits her circus animal sanctuary and poses as a passionate animal welfare patron, only to freeze in terror when Ulrika invites him into the enclosure to feed the hungry wolves.

scenes.title: A Nanny Mafia
scenes.summary: Overwhelmed after losing her daycare spot and bringing baby Flora to ASK for a week, Andréa despairs over two-year nanny waitlists. Rival agent Élise Formain surprises her with maternal empathy, advising Andréa on motherhood before promising to use her insider network to secure an elite nanny.

scenes.title: The Golden Dress
scenes.summary: Arriving at ASK in a glamorous golden gown from a nearby photoshoot, Sofia Leprince is playfully greeted by Gabriel as Charlize Theron. When Gabriel tells her Camille is in a meeting, Sofia heads to Camille's office to wait for her agent.

scenes.title: Sandrine's True Love
scenes.summary: Sarah tries to reassure a distracted Gabriel that Sandrine Kiberlain will quickly tire of stand-up comedy and return to her true love, cinema. Realizing Gabriel is not listening to a word she says, an exasperated Sarah walks out despite his attempts to invite her out.

scenes.title: The Missed Audition
scenes.summary: Returning to her office, Camille is furious to discover that Sofia skipped a crucial audition with director Paul Verhoeven on a friend's advice. The argument escalates when Camille realizes Sofia also borrowed and stretched out her brand-new designer shoes for a photoshoot.

scenes.title: A Rising Star
scenes.summary: After wrapping an intense scene on set, Hervé is showered with praise for his deeply moving performance. In his dressing room, makeup artist Véro secretly reveals that the director is considering him for a substantial role in her next film.

scenes.title: An Inappropriate Toast
scenes.summary: At Mathias's office party celebrating the acquisition of book rights, Mathias makes cynical jokes about handicapped animals and mocks the author Ulrika, prompting a disgusted Noémie to storm out in tears while Camille resolves to confront her father.

scenes.title: The Paternity Recognition
scenes.summary: Camille visits Mathias's apartment to discuss her lost adaptation contract and announces that she has decided to accept official paternity recognition. Deeply touched, Mathias offers to download the legal forms from his computer while pouring drinks.

scenes.title: The Betrayal Discovered
scenes.summary: Sitting at Mathias's computer while he is in the kitchen, Camille is stunned to read an open draft email revealing Mathias made false promises to author Ulrika to steal her away from ASK with plans to sideline her.

scenes.title: Betrayal by Email
scenes.summary: After agreeing to sign the paternity recognition papers, Camille discovers private emails on Mathias's computer showing he plotted to deceive and discard director Ulrika. Crushed by his manipulation, Camille rejects his excuses and storms out.

scenes.title: The Stand-Up Disaster
scenes.summary: Paralyzed by stage fright before performing stand-up comedy, Sandrine Kiberlain takes the stage and bombs with absurd jokes about vegetables. Backstage, she furiously blames Gabriel for pushing her into comedy and forces him to sign her up for her beloved costume drama.

scenes.title: The Scooter Escape
scenes.summary: While waiting for a taxi after her disastrous comedy gig, Sandrine spots an electric scooter on the street. Despite Gabriel's frantic protests about danger and lack of a helmet, she speeds away into the Parisian night.

scenes.title: Confidences at the Bar
scenes.summary: Unwinding over drinks at a Parisian bar, Andréa and rival agent Élise form an unexpected bond. After Élise delays Andréa's nanny so they can stay out, the two agents share hilarious confidential horror stories about their most demanding celebrity clients.

scenes.title: Camille Valentini, I am absent
scenes.summary: Mathias calls Camille and leaves a voicemail asking for her forgiveness.

scenes.title: Your methods are revolting
scenes.summary: Mathias furiously calls Ulrika to cancel their deal, defending Camille.

scenes.title: Music in the head
scenes.summary: A beautiful song plays as the episode concludes.

scenes.title: A Sincere Song
scenes.summary: At a Parisian music club, Sandrine Kiberlain takes the stage to perform a moving melody about childhood memories and freedom, choosing her true love for singing over stand-up comedy as Gabriel cheers her on.

scenes.title: The Limits of Kindness
scenes.summary: After driving across Paris to rescue Sofia from a cloakroom mishap, Gabriel sets firm boundaries and refuses to be her chauffeur to an afterparty in Chatou, reminding her that he must stop being overly accommodating.
scenes.location: Rue parisienne / Devant la boîte de nuit

scenes.title: Terrible News
scenes.summary: Over coffee at a Parisian bistro, Camille and Noémie vent their deep frustration at Mathias and mockingly compare him to Jafar, before a sudden phone call from the hospital reveals that Mathias has suffered a severe heart attack.

scenes.title: Race to the Hospital
scenes.summary: Panicked by the news of Mathias's heart attack, Camille and Noémie urgently hail a taxi in the street and race to the hospital emergency room to be by his side.
